title: File Portal VW-E2 deterministic structural-capture report v1
$comment: Produced-report schema only; an early STOPPED event has no capture report and is represented by the separate event receipt. Canonical identity JSON is UTF-8 without BOM or terminal newline; persisted report bytes are those canonical bytes followed by exactly one LF. Object keys are sorted, separators compact, ensure_ascii=false, duplicate members/NaN/infinity rejected, fixed decimals rounded ROUND_HALF_EVEN, and negative zero normalized to positive zero. Every identity hash is SHA-256 over its packet-frozen UTF-8 domain followed by one 0x00 byte and the canonical projection. report_id uses domain file-portal/vw-e2-report/r2 and the complete report with report_id omitted; capture_payload_sha256 uses domain file-portal/vw-e2-capture-core/r2 and capture_payload with capture_payload_sha256 omitted; config_sha256 uses domain file-portal/vw-e2-config/r2 and the complete frozen_configuration. primitive_id projects exactly {source_sha256,page_1based,kind,method,bbox_pdf_pt,bbox_px_half_open,identity_attributes}; candidate_id projects exactly {source_sha256,page_1based,bbox_pdf_pt,bbox_px_half_open,classes,config_sha256,source_primitive_ids}; relationship_id projects exactly {source_candidate_id,target_candidate_id,kind}. A primitive's engine ordinal, raw unrotated geometry, coordinate-derivation evidence, relationship measurements, crop hashes, tile IDs, timestamps, and resource observations are provenance and never identity. capture_schema_sha256 is the bare lowercase SHA-256 of these exact schema-file bytes and is not a const here because the packet binds the schema hash. All identity arrays use packet order and are checked for reference closure. JSON Schema validation alone does not prove sibling arithmetic, equality, references, hashes, ordering, protected-tree identity, privacy, or semantic provenance; every required semantic_checks entry must be produced by the separately hashed validator and independently sampled before an event receipt may claim COMPLETE.

numerator_name.const: valid rendered page pixels covered by at least one declared base tile

denominator_name.const: valid rendered page pixels on attempted readable pages

record_encoding.const: canonical JSON array of logical_id,bytes,sha256 sorted by logical_id; absolute paths, titles, and basenames omitted
